production_notes: Prefer real product material and deterministic, reproducible motion for promos
Browser-rendered motion can avoid image/video inference calls, but rendering time and hardware needs still apply
Game examples are references for lighting and camera work, not direct replacements for the existing 3D dialogue pipeline
Named model provenance and benchmark or virality claims remain author reports unless independently verified
Check each copied code and media license separately; GitHub license metadata is not a full asset audit
No external paid API calls, subscriptions or generated media without the project cost controls
